create_variable_client: create a VariableClient that fetches variables from a remote source with periodic updates
update_variables_async: call update on a VariableClient to asynchronously fetch the latest variables from the source
update_variables_blocking: call update with wait=True on a VariableClient to block until variables are fetched
create_reference_variable_source: create a ReferenceVariableSource that returns VariableReference objects instead of actual variable values
get_client_params: access the params property on a VariableClient to retrieve the current network parameters
